rules: The code travels in result.reason and per step in result.steps[].reason; error.code stays the ADR 0013 name.
exit_alone is the command exit status when this is the only outcome; when something was also applied the command exits 73.
Codes are stable and never reused; a new code is appended.

codes.when: platform is not darwin and not the Linux enrollment route, or doctor --fix off darwin
darwin: uid 0 or SUDO_USER set
another real run holds the run lock
doctor --fix without a host profile
the protocol cannot be created; no mutation happens
unattended run lacks --yes, --confirm <id> or input; names the flags
privileged step without a terminal, with --json or --non-interactive, or unconfirmed; sudo not run
--only, --skip or --confirm names an id not in the catalogue
a flag of another platform or mode
schema or loader rule violated
plan hash differs between confirmation and apply
brew not found at its canonical paths; step blocked, instructions printed
brew exited nonzero (offline, conflict); bounded tail kept
version after install or upgrade is below min_version
sudo exited nonzero or the owner declined its prompt
the step deadline passed
a required step failed or was declined; step blocked
dotfile or git target is a symlink, special file or outside HOME
target bytes differ from the previewed state at write time
backup could not be created or verified; no write happened
symlink, relative include, GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL or foreign XDG_CONFIG_HOME, git lock file, or verification failed (restored); the reason detail names which
item recorded as opted out; not changed
the owner answered no to a step
